{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The same human economic activity has brought freedom and opportunity to billions and has also increased the amount of carbon in the atmosphere.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The scope and long-term consequences of increased carbon in the atmosphere are the subject of ongoing scientific research.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States should take measured and reasonable steps today to reduce any impact on the environment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Steps to reduce environmental impact should be consistent with global competitiveness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Steps to reduce environmental impact will also be good for national security.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Steps to reduce environmental impact will also be good for energy independence.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Steps to reduce environmental impact will also be good for the economy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any policies to reduce environmental impact should be global in nature.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any policies to reduce environmental impact should be based on sound science and technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Any policies to reduce environmental impact should not harm the economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support technology-driven, market-based solutions to decrease emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support technology-driven, market-based solutions to reduce excess greenhouse gasses in the atmosphere.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support technology-driven, market-based solutions to increase energy efficiency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support technology-driven, market-based solutions to mitigate the impact of climate change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support technology-driven, market-based solutions to maximize any ancillary benefits climate change might offer for the economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"To reduce emissions in the short run, the United States will rely upon the power of new technologies, especially zero-emission energy sources such as nuclear and other alternate power sources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Innovation must not be hamstrung by Washington bickering, regulatory briar patches, or obstructionist lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Empowering Washington will only lead to unintended consequences and unimagined economic and environmental pain.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Unleashing the power of scientific know-how and competitive markets is necessary.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
